title: Target-conditioned functional portal binding head
summary: Score each functional portal independently against a public target reference pack, summarize the candidate set symmetrically, and represent target absence with an explicit NONE logit.

mechanisms.name: Shared portal scorer plus symmetric set summary and NONE
mechanisms.description: Freeze CLIP, DINOv2, and the dual-family portal proposer. Build candidate-local, expanded-context, upper-facade, global-identity, structural, and support-ray features. Apply one shared MLP to every candidate; derive NONE from mean/max/min set summaries; train with multi-positive listwise likelihood.
mechanisms.limitations: The first building-disjoint confirmation collapsed to universal NONE. Latent Top-3 ranking was 6/6 and wrong-target rejection 30/30, but correct COMMIT/SET_VALUED coverage was 0/6. The learned embedding/fusion arm is closed on that cohort.
